versions.text: Verify accessibility to propulsion-system-related equipment for the performance of required servicing, inspections, and maintenance. DoD/MIL Doc: JSSG-2001B: 3.3.1.1/4.3.1.1

Criterion: Verify reasonable accessibility to propulsion-system-related equipment for the performance of flight critical servicing, inspections, and maintenance. Standard: Flight critical installed propulsion system servicing, inspections, and maintenance activities can be accomplished by the multivariate maintainer population. Access accommodates the maintainer's anthropometric dimensions and strength limitations, taking into consideration all environmental conditions, and any required mission equipment (e.g., chemical protective gear, gloves). Method of Compliance: Verification methods include analysis, demonstration, inspection and review of documentation. Inspection of design criteria (to include Interface Control Document data) establishes required servicing, inspections and maintenance requirements. Analysis of virtual models or physical mock-ups verifies accessibility to required servicing, inspection and maintenance areas. Maintenance demonstration verifies the ability to accomplish required tasks.

Standard: Propulsion systems are designed to allow servicing, inspections, and maintenance activities. Access accommodates the maintenance equipment, maintainer limitations, and environmental conditions (e.g., chemical protective gear, gloves). Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Review documentation (e.g., hardware drawings, system configuration descriptions, materials and manufacturing records, design data records, inspection reports, photographs, ICD, or other substantiating records and reports) to verify the installed engine accessibility. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Analysis.
  (1) Virtual models or physical mock-ups verify the installed engine accessibility. Demonstration.
    (1) Demonstrate accessibility on the installed engine.
